# Kokoro TTS for Runpod Serverless (OpenAI-compatible)

> A Runpod Hub Serverless worker for Kokoro-82M text-to-speech with an OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech API. 54 voices in 8 languages, weighted voice blending, mp3/wav/flac/opus/pcm. Model weights are baked into the image, so a cold start does not download anything. A 16 GB GPU is enough. Use this when you need Kokoro TTS on Runpod, a self-hosted tts-1-style endpoint, or an OpenAI SDK-compatible speech API.

Use this file to decide what to read next. Prefer the raw Markdown links. Deploy from the Runpod Hub (the console URL is live only after moderation): https://console.runpod.io/hub/prilojject/runpod-kokoro-tts

Queue mode (default): POST /runsync with {"input":{"input":"...","voice":"af_heart","response_format":"mp3"}} and decode output.audio_base64. HTTP mode (WORKER_MODE=http, load-balancing endpoint or Pod): OpenAI SDK against https://<ENDPOINT_ID>.api.runpod.ai/v1. Japanese voices are not installed by default. Blackwell GPUs are not supported by this CUDA 12.4 build. This worker does not implement captioned timestamps or phoneme endpoints.
